# A build that generated nothing at all fails, rather than exiting 0 in silence
# (#232). The per-unit skip stays at INFO; it is the whole invocation that has
# to say so.
! sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --out=out nowindow/
stderr 'nothing to generate: nothing rendered at the root of a file in nowindow'
! exists out/index.html

# Naming the file rather than the directory is the same failure from the other
# side: naming it is the request, so it is emitted and internal/build reports it.
! sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --out=out2 nowindow/lib.sngl
stderr 'a program renders something at the root of a file'

# One unit emitting is a successful build even though a sibling package skipped
# -- which is examples/calculator, and what the rule above must not break.
sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --out=out3 app/
stdout 'out3/index.html'
exists out3/index.html

-- nowindow/lib.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component card(label = "") node {
    text(value=label)
}
-- app/app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component main node {
    text(value="hi")
}

window {
    main
}
-- app/widgets/card.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component card(label = "") node {
    text(value=label)
}
